description.description: Optional literal VM description shown in Prism. Supports multiline text; frozen at creation intent. Changes apply only to new machines, not existing VMs. Provider limit: 2048 characters.

cpu.description: vCPU sockets. Total vCPUs = cpu * cores.

disk_gb.description: Boot disk in GiB; must be at least the Talos image size.

cluster_name.description: Target AHV cluster registered with Prism Central.

cluster_uuid.description: Target AHV cluster extId. Preferred over names.

container_name.description: Storage container name, scoped to the selected cluster.

container_uuid.description: Storage container UUID on the selected cluster.

subnet_name.description: VLAN or overlay subnet. VLAN names are cluster-scoped; overlay names can be VPC-scoped.

subnet_uuid.description: Prism Central subnet extId; recommended for advanced networking.

vpc_name.description: VPC scope for the primary overlay subnet.

vpc_uuid.description: VPC extId for the primary overlay subnet.

image_name.description: Existing Talos OpenStack-platform disk image. Leave blank when automatic image import is enabled.

image_uuid.description: Existing Prism Central DISK_IMAGE extId. Leave blank when automatic image import is enabled.

image_import.title: Automatic image import
image_import.description: Import the requested Talos version/extensions onto the VM's selected AHV cluster only. Requires provider enablement. Clear image_name and image_uuid when checked. No separate image destination selector, image updates or automatic deletion.

initial_extensions.title: Initial Talos extensions
initial_extensions.description: Optional official extension names, for example siderolabs/qemu-guest-agent. Requires Automatic image import. Added to Omni's requested extensions, sorted and deduplicated (maximum 256 combined). Included only when freezing a new Talos image plan; editing this list does not update existing machines or frozen plans. Omni manages later extension upgrades separately.

categories.description: Existing Prism Central VM categories assigned at creation. Select by uuid or key/value. May activate existing Flow security policies; definitions/policies are not created or updated.

additional_disks.description: Ephemeral raw disks. Like the boot disk and config drive, any mismatched disks are automatically migrated to container_name/container_uuid before power-on. Deleted with the VM; not preserved on replacement.

gpu.description: Exact physical GPU or vGPU device/profile names in the selected cluster. One name per GPU; repeat a name to request identical GPUs. IDs, vendor and mode are resolved internally and frozen before creation. PC/AHV enforce capacity and placement. Talos GPU extensions/drivers and Kubernetes device plugins are configured separately.

additional_nics.description: Additional NICs with independent subnet and VPC selectors.
